            self.spy_sma.update(spy_bar.end_time, spy_bar.close)

                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.update(aapl_bar.end_time, aapl_bar.close)
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.close

        # Skip all rule evaluation unless every subscribed ticker has today's bar.
        if any(not data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            if data.bars.contains_key(self.spy):
                self.previous_spy_close = data.bars[self.spy].close
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value if self.spy_sma.is_ready else None
            return

        spy_bar = data.bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.aapl]

        if not self.spy_sma.is_ready or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value if self.spy_sma.is_ready else None
            return

        if self.previous_spy_close is None or self.previous_spy_sma is None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
            return

        current_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
        crosses_above_sma = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.close > current_sma
        )
        crosses_below_sma = (
            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.close < current_sma
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and crosses_below_sma:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > self.rsi_threshold:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and crosses_above_sma:
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value) / spy_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close
        self.previous_spy_sma = current_sma
